evals.prompt: just watched this one on rare chords in video game music, can you give me some composition exercises from it? transcripts/evals/FekJvtUX6oA.txt
evals.expected_output: transcripts/evals/FekJvtUX6oA.prompts.md with 6-10 video-specific, constrained, sized prompts
assertions: Has between 6 and 10 numbered prompts
Every prompt is labelled with a size (Warm-up / Study / Sketch) and a time estimate
Every prompt names which idea from the video it practises
Every prompt has a self-check line (Listen for / Check)
Every prompt gives concrete constraints (key/mode, meter, or bar count)
Prompts are instrument-agnostic (no instrument required unless an alternative is offered)
Includes a 'Key ideas from the video' summary and the source URL
